answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The ocean graph is validated at intake and the onyx frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and karst anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Duplicating the work 173 times multiplies the fee by 178 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
